notice: PLACEHOLDER PATHWAY - DEMO TIMING. Every duration in this file is the placeholder value from ../breast-screening.json divided by 1800, so one pathway hour passes in 2 real seconds and a journey can be shown live. It exists only for development and demos and must never be used for real follow-up. Nothing in this file is clinically approved. Every code, role, duration and evidence rule is a placeholder to be replaced by values a clinical adviser signs off. Stage entry and exit rules are a proposal still to be confirmed by the team.

changeLog.summary: Reply deadline placeholders follow screen 4 of the design (decision 18): respond-to-referral 4 hours, answer-consultation 1 day, call-patient 2 hours, as clock time because no working-hours calendar exists.
